title.narrative: Increased capacities of constituents to develop and implement an integrated policy response on employment and social protection

description.narrative: Following on the development of the Productive Employment Program 2023-2027 in Tajikistan, the ILO will provide technical assistance to the constituents in establishing the observatory of the labour market to monitor and analyse the labour market trends, including understanding and anticipating skills mismatch. The ILO will also support efforts the Government and relevant stakeholders to address main gender gaps and inequalities in the labour market to improve women's employability. The list of banned occupations will be analyses and policy recommendations to eliminate the list will be developed to improve women’s access to the labour market. Additionally, the ILO will assist in reforming Tajikistan's social protection system as outlined in the National Strategy on Social Protection, which includes improving governance, implementing a digital management information system, guaranteeing social protection rights for migrant workers and extension social protection coverage.
